And now I've returned to inspecting browser HIIT timers... As a refresher:

How do I find the JavaScript file in a website?
Open the webpage in your web browser.
Right-click anywhere on the page and select “Inspect” or “Inspect Element”.
A pane will appear at the bottom or right side of your browser window, displaying the HTML and CSS code behind the page.
To view the JavaScript code, select the “Sources” tab in the “Inspector” pane.
